run_segments_intersect: run segment intersection algorithm on two line segments given four x and y coordinates
run_graham_scan: run the Graham scan algorithm to compute the convex hull of a set of 2D points
run_jarvis_march: run Jarvis march algorithm to compute the convex hull of a set of 2D points
review_segments_intersect_direction: review the direction and on_segment helper functions used in the segment intersection algorithm
review_graham_scan_counter_clockwise: review the counter_clockwise helper function used in the Graham scan convex hull algorithm
